quote: MIPA Schedule 3.6: Lists only (1) Brandywine Flats Industrial LLC (landlord consent) and (2) Keystone Commonwealth Bank (lender consent). **Velloran's consent is not listed.** ... MIPA § 7.1(d): Closing is conditioned on "each of the Required Consents listed on Schedule 3.6 shall have been obtained..." ... Under § 14.2, this is deemed an assignment requiring Velloran's prior written consent. Under § 14.3, if the Change of Control occurs without that consent, Velloran may terminate the Distribution Agreement *immediately*. ... Add Velloran's written consent to the Change of Control as a new item on Schedule 3.6 of the MIPA, making it a Required Consent and therefore a condition to Closing under § 7.1(d). ... Begin the consent request to Velloran immediately.
reason: The memo meets every element of the criterion. It treats the 100% sale as a Change of Control requiring Velloran's prior written consent under DA § 14.2, and it cites the immediate termination right in § 14.3. It states that Schedule 3.6 omits the Velloran consent, so the consent is not a closing condition under § 7.1(d). It recommends adding the consent to Schedule 3.6 and starting the consent request right away. The memo does not mention § 6.4, but the criterion only requires § 6.4 and/or § 7.1(d), and § 7.1(d) is covered.
